KPE licenses this APK separately from SOTI. Import a key, then activate explicitly; repeated MDM delivery does not reactivate the same key. License status and granted permissions are separate from measured API availability. No key is exported in profiles, telemetry or logs. The four storage APIs are deprecated from Knox API 35 and may be unavailable. CPU, temperature and battery wear are not unlocked automatically. Managed settings are read-only; the administrator supplies the key and activation action separately.
